text:
This looks like a leftover portion of fried rice with vegetables (carrots, green beans, peppers) in sauce, on a paper plate. There is also a sauce-stained tortilla or wrap remnant. I estimate about 150 g of rice and vegetables at roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, which is about 225 kcal. The tortilla remnant adds a bit, perhaps 30 g and 90 kcal, so I use about 300 kcal total and about 180 g.

{"kcal": 300, "mass_g": 180}
